g.text: Model: response = 2 × one-way light-time + 2 × mean wait for a contact, (1 − f)²P/2 for contact fraction f and cycle P, + 30 min for a ground
decision. (b) compares it with each event's time constant (fault, guidance 1 min; driving hazard 10 s; science event 2 h; plan change 6 h; conjunction
1 day): ratio < 0.3 ground in the loop (E2); 0.3–10 onboard reactions (E3, F1); ≥ 10 onboard re-planning (E4); F2 where ground recovery takes ≥ 6 h or
in critical phases. Illustrative heuristic, not an ECSS rule.
